notes: Answers: items 9 to 15 come from the city planning department (or the county's, outside city limits), as the form says. Items 14 and 15 (the planner's phone and email) have no fillable box on this PDF, so they are printed on their rows. 'None' leaves an optional line blank. The signature and the date signed are left for the applicant; the ABC-use-only block stays blank.
